name: fence_build
doc: Builds a fence network (design/planner.md, Walls, fences, and gates) on the hex grid's diagonal lattice (line_v1_network), or one chunk of it, as one model at its nodes' heights, from its kind (a config entry: pickets, rails, split rails, wattle hurdles, a hedge, a low dry-stone wall, or iron railings; height, thickness, colours, post spacing): runs rising with the ground, posts along them and one at every node (a hedge's clump or a wall's pier where it ends, bends, or branches), and a gate that swings open by door_time in each opening its gate nodes and links leave. A hedge sways a little and turns with the season; collision, and guides showing the lattice and its openings.
